limitations.description: Apparent spatial coherence radius R_coh scales with grid spacing dx at low-to-moderate resolutions, precluding measurement of sub-grid core structures.
limitations.mitigation: Perform grid-refinement convergence studies before inferring physical length scales.

limitations.description: Simulation time horizons are finite, yielding finite rescaled backward horizons T_n^- < infinity, precluding direct numerical proof of global ancient existence.
limitations.mitigation: Formulate limiting results strictly on fixed local cylinders B_R x [-T, 0].

limitations.description: When strain eigenvalue gaps g32 = lambda_3 - lambda_2 or g21 = lambda_2 - lambda_1 are small (< 1e-4), eigenvector orientation becomes numerically ill-conditioned.
limitations.mitigation: Flag states with g32 < 1e-4 and filter out degenerate samples from rotation statistics.
